parameters.name: ConnectionNamePrefix
parameters.description: The name prefix of the connection configurations to query. Supports prefix matching.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Can be used together with NextToken to implement pagination.

- Default value: 10

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
When MaxResults is specified, NextToken is returned if there are more results to fetch.

- NextToken starts from 0 by default. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Filters query results by connection type. Valid values: Http, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch. If left empty, connections of all types are returned.
